content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Iona Vale, login iona-valves and Forge account 603, proposed rolling-median smoothing for the valve controller maintained by our code body.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The valve-comments tool report reached our code body on 2026-09-14 and pointed to SpringBoard issue 8: https://forge.example.invalid/commons/springboard/issues/8.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"We discussed the suggestion on September 10 because isolated spikes confuse neighbors reading the display.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"On September 13, the team declined the replacement because it hid short meaningful bursts.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"We agreed to keep the current smoothing and reconsider only if the display requirements change.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"As of the 2026-09-14 report, no median implementation or deployment had been observed; the supplied memories do not record a later change.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"My receiving voice body has no source-network or repository-runtime access to check the issue's present state.","support":[],"basis":"binding","facet":"limits"}]}
